fixes: Capture frames that actually show the new east segment: one foot frame and one vehicle frame looking east along X22..60 with reused facade and fence meshes visible on both sides (matching the reported 6.53 m foot / 9.93 m vehicle outside samples), plus a following frame after the physical return inside the alley/core. Currently every supplied frame is either the pre-X22 alley or a bare slab pocket, so no outside leg is visibly documented.

Report traversal distance beyond each prior rectangle separately (min distance beyond X-1..6,Z-2..30 and beyond X6..22,Z8..20, each >= 6 m) instead of a single 'maximum_distance_beyond_old_boundary' scalar; a single east-side number does not prove both old rectangles were exited by 6 m.

Re-shoot the outside/return legs without the MISSION FAILED overlay (or with the mission timer extended): frame-007 (39.35 s) and frame-010 (50.50 s) both show 'Ran out of time / Press R to retry', which makes the vehicle return evidence ambiguous with respect to the no-reset requirement.

Fix camera clipping during the return drive: frame-010 has the third-person camera inside the coupe roof/body and the frame is unreadable geometry. Preserve the accepted camera rig but add occlusion push-out so the camera never enters vehicle or building volumes on the new street.

Show visible closure of the new outer edges: frame-000 and frame-002 look out past walls into open grey void with bare wall tops and no facade/fence treatment, so 'close every new outer edge' is unproven. Add/frame the east cap at X60 and the Z8/Z28 edge closures with the reused boundary mesh and a matching collider, and include a frame looking at that cap.
critic.summary:
Numeric topology evidence is partly present but the visual proof required by this scope is not delivered by the supplied frames. Positives: build clean (exit 0, no compile errors); scene inventory intact (2538 renderers / 46 colliders observed = declared); walking-support surfaces include a new "WorldCollision/StreetPavement" spanning X22..60, Z8..28 with top Y ≈ 0.14, i.e. the provisional footprint exists and is walkable; prop-clone parity (bollards, dumpster body/wheels/rail/lid) matches source size and orientation; all listed regressions (walk, world, motor, courier, failure-retry, combat foot/wall/driving, aim) pass. Traversal is recorded (foot 14 outside samples, max 6.53 m; vehicle 33 outside samples, max 9.93 m; returns 20.98 s / 43.83 s inside the 150 s budget, no R-reset flag in the trace).

However, acceptance also demands visible captures of each outside leg and its return, and none of the four native frames show the new east street. frame-002 (t=17.90 s) and frame-007 (t=39.35 s) show only a bare, sky-open orange slab enclosure with no reused facade/window/fence detail and no street reading as a continuation past X22; frame-010 (t=50.50 s) has the camera buried inside the coupe's roof/body, so the actor and route are unreadable. Both late frames carry a "MISSION FAILED / Press R to retry" overlay, so the return-leg captures were taken in a dead-mission state and cannot serve as clean control/route evidence. The reported distance beyond the old boundary is a single scalar per mode, so "at least 6 m beyond BOTH prior rectangles" is not established (only one axis of the union is demonstrably exceeded). Rough blockout art itself is acceptable at this foundation milestone; the missing visible east-street support, the camera-in-geometry clipping, and the per-rectangle/return proof gaps are in-scope defects.

review_annotations: The original FIX is preserved unchanged. The gate computes the minimum of the distances outside both prior rectangles; a minimum >=6 establishes the criterion for each rectangle. A single reported scalar here is not evidence that only one rectangle was checked.

The trace explicitly verifies physical returns and absence of R/reset discontinuity. The old courier timeout overlay remains a visual clarity defect; by itself it does not negate those physical records.
The critic's geometry/readability findings remain open. Complete numerical traversal/support does not establish a visually coherent street or final presentation.
